question: Which of the following lakes is located in Buldhana district of Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lonar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lonar** Lake is located in the Buldhana district of Maharashtra.
 
• It is a saline soda lake, created by a meteor impact during the Pleistocene Epoch.
 
• The lake is one of the four known hyper-velocity impact craters in basaltic rock anywhere on Earth.
 
• The crater has a mean diameter of 1.2 kilometers and is about 137 meters below the crater rim.
 
• Lonar Lake is also known for its unique ecosystem, which includes various algae, plankton, and microbial life forms that thrive in its high-salinity environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lonar Lake** has been a subject of scientific studies due to its unique geological and ecological features.
 
• The lake is surrounded by a variety of flora and fauna, making it a significant site for biodiversity.
 
• It is also a popular tourist destination and is considered a geological wonder.
 
• The lake has been declared a National Geo-heritage Monument by the Geological Survey of India.
 
• Efforts are ongoing to preserve and protect the lake from pollution and other environmental threats.
